## About a2a.so
URL: https://a2a.so/about
Updated: Wed Oct 14 2026 07:00:00 GMT+0700 (Indochina Time)

a2a.so is an independent community resource for developers, product teams, and agents evaluating the Agent2Agent protocol. It aims to make primary documentation, ecosystem signals, and useful repositories easier to find.

## Editorial approach

We keep claims short, link them to public sources, distinguish announced support from documented deployments, and retain prior live measurements if a source API is unavailable.

## Ownership and contact

a2a.so is owned by Avada Group. For corrections, open an issue in the site repository when it is available.

## A2A use cases
URL: https://a2a.so/use-cases
Updated: Wed Oct 14 2026 07:00:00 GMT+0700 (Indochina Time)

The examples below are patterns documented by public sources. They are not claims about named customer outcomes.

## Hosted A2A servers

Deploy an A2A server on AWS AgentCore Runtime, with OAuth or SigV4 authentication. [AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/runtime-a2a.md)

## Copilot Studio connections

Use a Copilot Studio agent to call external, third-party agents. [Microsoft announcement](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-cloud/blog/2025/05/07/empowering-multi-agent-apps-with-the-open-agent2agent-a2a-protocol/)

## Specialist delegation

An orchestrator can delegate to specialists built with different frameworks, such as a LangGraph orchestrator working with ADK or CrewAI agents. [Semantic Kernel example](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/semantic-kernel/guest-blog-building-multi-agent-solutions-with-semantic-kernel-and-a2a-protocol/)

## Commerce and payments

The Linux Foundation describes AP2 and A2A work as part of agentic commerce and payments. [Linux Foundation release](https://linuxfoundation.org/press/a2a-protocol-surpasses-150-organizations-lands-in-major-cloud-platforms-and-sees-enterprise-production-use-in-first-year)

## Test and inspect agents

Use [A2A Inspector](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-inspector) and the [A2A Technology Compatibility Kit](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-tck) for inspection and validation.

## Multi-agent samples

Public samples include a travel assistant and a slide-generation project that combine A2A with other agent tooling. [GitHub repository search](https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=a2a+agent2agent+in:name,description,topics)

## Framework scaffolding

The AgentCore CLI documents A2A scaffolding with Strands, LangChain/LangGraph, and Google ADK. [AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/runtime-a2a.md)

## What is A2A?
URL: https://a2a.so/what-is-a2a
Updated: Wed Oct 14 2026 07:00:00 GMT+0700 (Indochina Time)

The Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol gives independently built agents a shared way to discover capabilities, exchange messages, and manage work. [A2A documentation](https://a2a-protocol.org/)

## The core objects

An Agent Card is published at `/.well-known/agent-card.json`. It describes an agent's skills and interfaces so another agent can discover it. [AWS AgentCore A2A guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/runtime-a2a.md)

Tasks represent units of work. Messages carry Parts, including text, raw data, URLs, and media. [A2A v1.0 changes](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/whats-new-v1/)

## Transports and v1.0

A2A supports JSON-RPC, gRPC, and REST transports. Version 1.0 added verb-style operations, a unified Part model, `supportedInterfaces`, signed Agent Cards, device-code OAuth, and cursor pagination. [A2A v1.0 changes](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/whats-new-v1/)

## A2A and MCP

MCP is for an agent’s connection to tools and data; A2A is for agent discovery, delegation, and collaboration. They are complementary protocols. [AAIF ecosystem overview](https://aaif.io/blog/where-a2a-fits-in-the-open-agent-ecosystem)

## Why A2A exists
URL: https://a2a.so/why-a2a
Updated: Wed Oct 14 2026 07:00:00 GMT+0700 (Indochina Time)

Agents built by different vendors need a common way to describe capabilities, delegate tasks, and return results. A2A defines that interaction layer. [A2A documentation](https://a2a-protocol.org/)

## For teams

A shared protocol can reduce dependence on one agent vendor and make it easier to compose specialist agents. A2A's public contributors include cloud and enterprise software companies. [Linux Foundation announcement](https://developers.googleblog.com/google-cloud-donates-a2a-to-linux-foundation/)

## For agents

Agent Cards support discovery. Tasks and messages support delegation and collaboration. A2A also specifies signed cards and device-code OAuth. [A2A v1.0 changes](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/whats-new-v1/)

## A practical guide to Agent2Agent
URL: https://a2a.so/
Updated: Wed Oct 14 2026 07:00:00 GMT+0700 (Indochina Time)

A2A is an open protocol for agents to discover one another, delegate work, and collaborate across systems. [Official documentation](https://a2a-protocol.org/)

## A protocol for agent-to-agent work

It complements MCP: MCP connects agents to tools and data, while A2A connects agents to other agents. [AAIF ecosystem overview](https://aaif.io/blog/where-a2a-fits-in-the-open-agent-ecosystem)
